wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-dialog:
Title of the dialog where the user can share the article.
{{Identical|Share}}
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-copy-l: Label for the button that copies the article link to the clipboard.
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-link-c: Label shown after the link has been copied to the clipboard.
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-share:
Label for the share button in the share dialog.
{{Identical|Share}}
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-downlo:
Label for the download button, and for the primary button when the Web Share API is not available.
{{Identical|Download}}
Label shown while the image is being processed for download.
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-loadin: Text shown while the share card's data is being loaded.
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-genera: Text shown while the share card image is being generated.
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-share-:
Title used when sharing an article via the Web Share API.

Parameters:
* $1: the article title
* $2: the project name (e.g. 'Wikipedia')

Text body used when sharing an article via the Web Share API.

Parameters:
* $1: the truncated article extract
* $2: the URL of the article
* $3: the project name (e.g. 'Wikipedia')
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-image-:
Credit for the image used on the share card.

Parameters:
* $1: short name of the image's license
* $2: the image author(s) name(s)

Credit for the image used on the share card, when only its license or only its author is known.

Parameters:
* $1: short name of the image's license, or the image author(s) name(s)
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-page-v:
Number of times the article was viewed in the last 30 days, shown on the share card as a monthly rate. Use the separator or phrasing that is natural in your language (e.g. "views per month" or "monthly views"); the slash is not required.

Parameters:
* $1: the number of views, for PLURAL
* $2: the number of views, in compact form (e.g. '5M')
wikimediacustomizations-sharecard-refere:
Number of references the article cites, shown on the share card.

Parameters:
* $1: the number of references, for PLURAL
* $2: the number of references, in compact form (e.g. '10K')
